{{Quote|Whyren's Reserve, Batch Number NN182. The rarest of the rare. I could sell the ''Falcon'' and maybe&mdash;''maybe''&mdash;buy a case of this stuff.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 3">[[Star Wars (2013) 3|''Star Wars'' (2013) 3]]</ref>}}
'''''Whyren's Reserve''''', also spelled '''''Whyrren's Reserve''''' or '''Rywen's Reserve''', was a rare, expensive [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]]. It had an amber color and a crisp, woody taste. It was a favorite of the black market trade. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was fond of the drink. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] estimated that a case of extremely rare Whyren's Reserve batch number [[NN182]] was equivalent to, if not more valuable than, the cost of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
